Remote ID flood detector

A counter-drone sensor has decoded every Remote ID broadcast in the air. Hundreds are fakes from one spoofing tool. One is a real drone. This page generates that flood in your browser, runs the receive-only detector over it, and points at the single real track, with the reasons it was chosen.

Flood built by remoteid-scenario · decoded by remoteid · graded by remoteid-sentinel, compiled to WebAssembly. Runs entirely offline in this tab. No radio, no network, no transmit path: this is analysis of decoded data only.

Real drone Fake broadcast Real flight path

Every number on this page comes from the real crates, run on real decoded frames. The fakes are spec-compliant Remote ID messages written to memory, never to a radio. Open source: remoteid, remoteid-sentinel, remoteid-scenario.
